methods.label: Projecting adjacent sides
methods.explanation: Since \(AD\) is parallel to the projection plane, its projected length remains 3. The projected length of \(AB\) is \(4\times\cos60^\circ=2\). The orthographic projection is a rectangle of length 2 and width 3, with area 6.
methods.levelReason: The method combines Grade 9 projection and special-angle cosine with elementary rectangle properties and area.

review.mathematicalCheck: AD projects with length 3. Because its direction is parallel to the projection plane, projecting AB preserves its perpendicularity to AD.
